practiceAtAGlance.title: You'll know who's treating you
practiceAtAGlance.body: Patients know the clinician behind the visit before they book.

practiceAtAGlance.title: What telehealth can treat
practiceAtAGlance.body: Services are explained in plain language so patients can choose confidently.

practiceAtAGlance.title: Clear guidance when you need more care
practiceAtAGlance.body: Some concerns need a local exam or urgent support, and that guidance is part of good care.

practiceAtAGlance.title: Instant online scheduling
practiceAtAGlance.body: No phone calls required — booking begins from the site and continues through the practice's scheduling path.

patientJourney.title: Book
patientJourney.description: Use the scheduling link to choose a visit time that works for you.

patientJourney.title: Prepare
patientJourney.description: Join 5-10 minutes early and have your ID, insurance card, medication list, and recent health information ready.

patientJourney.title: Consult
patientJourney.description: Meet with {providerName}, for a focused telehealth conversation.

patientJourney.title: Care plan
patientJourney.description: Leave with plain-language next steps and follow-up guidance.

patientJourney.title: Follow up
patientJourney.description: Continue care through the practice's follow-up process.

patientFit: Patients age {minimumAge} and up who want a direct provider relationship and a calmer care experience.
People who value evidence-based care, clear education, and shared decision-making.
Patients and families who want prevention, routine care, and chronic condition support explained plainly.

providerStandards.title: Evidence-based care
providerStandards.body: Care is grounded in clinical evidence, careful assessment, and a respectful understanding of each patient's goals, values, and concerns.

providerStandards.title: Clear communication
providerStandards.body: {providerFirstName} prioritizes active listening, patient education, and shared decision-making so patients feel informed and supported.

providerStandards.title: Holistic support
providerStandards.body: The practice helps patients and families understand their health, manage next steps, and participate actively in their well-being.

safetyBoundaries.title: Urgent symptoms need urgent care
safetyBoundaries.body: Chest pain, trouble breathing, stroke symptoms, severe allergic reactions, major injuries, or any emergency should be handled right away through emergency services.

safetyBoundaries.title: Keep health details in the visit
safetyBoundaries.body: The contact form is best for general questions. Personal medical details can be shared through the practice visit process.

safetyBoundaries.title: Some care is best in person
safetyBoundaries.body: If a concern needs an exam, testing, imaging, specialist care, or urgent support, the next step will be explained clearly.
